svg.title: Static routes, OSPF and BGP: how routers learn paths
svg.desc: OSPF finds the cheapest path inside one organisation; BGP chooses policy-based paths between organisations
svg.text: Static routes, OSPF and BGP: how routers learn paths
OSPF finds the cheapest path inside one organisation; BGP chooses policy-based paths between organisations
① Hello → neighbours ② flood link-state (LSAs) ③ identical map (LSDB) ④ SPF picks cheapest

Builds the routing table (OSPF, BGP, static routes)
Forwards each packet using that table
Fast, per packet, does the sending
Static = you tell it · OSPF = routers share a map and compute cheapest · BGP = organisations trade reachability by policy.
Default route 0.0.0.0/0 is just the least specific prefix: 'if nothing better matches, send it that way'.
